arxiv-2109-01931.title: Singularities in static spherically symmetric configurations of General Relativity with strongly nonlinear scalar fields
arxiv-2109-01931.creator: O. S. Stashko, V. I. Zhdanov
arxiv-2109-01931.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by O. S. Stashko, V. I. Zhdanov. There are a number of publications on relativistic objects dealing either with black holes or naked singularities in the center. Here we show that there exist static spherically symmetric solutions of Einstein equations with a strongly nonlinear scalar field with potential V ⁡ ( φ ) ∼ sinh ⁡ ( φ 2 ​ n ) V(\varphi)\sim\sinh(\varphi^{2n}) , which allow the appearance of singularities of a new type (“spherical singularities”) outside the center of isolated configuration.

arxiv-2111-06278.title: On Nash-solvability of finite n n -person deterministic graphical games; Catch 22
arxiv-2111-06278.creator: Vladimir Gurvich
arxiv-2111-06278.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vladimir Gurvich. We consider finite n n -person deterministic graphical (DG) games. These games are modelled by finite directed graphs (digraphs) G G which may have directed cycles and, hence, infinite plays. Yet, it is assumed that all these plays are equivalent and form a single outcome c c , while the terminal vertices V T = { a 1 , … , a p } V_{T}=\{a_{1},\ldots,a_{p}\} form p p remaining outcomes. We study the existence of Nash equilibria (NE) in pure stationary strategies.

arxiv-2208-11594.description: Abstract Active perception and foveal vision are the foundations of the human visual system. While foveal vision reduces the amount of information to process during a gaze fixation, active perception will change the gaze direction to the most promising parts of the visual field.

arxiv-2301-10867.title: Resolution of cosmological singularity in Hořava-Lifshitz cosmology
arxiv-2301-10867.creator: Ewa Czuchry
arxiv-2301-10867.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ewa Czuchry. The standard Λ \Lambda CDM model despite its agreement with observational data still has some issues unaddressed, lie the problem of initial singularity. Solving that problem usually requires modifications of general relativity. However, there appeared the Hořava-Lifshitz (HL) theory of gravity, in which equations governing cosmological evolution include a new term scaling similarly as dark radiation term in the Friedmann equations, enabling a bounce of the universe instead of initial singularity.

arxiv-2306-17793.title: Screw and Lie Group Theory in Multibody Dynamics Journal: Multibody System Dynamics
arxiv-2306-17793.creator: Andreas Müller
arxiv-2306-17793.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andreas Müller. Screw and Lie group theory allows for user-friendly modeling of multibody systems (MBS) while at the same they give rise to computationally efficient recursive algorithms. The inherent frame invariance of such formulations allows for use of arbitrary reference frames within the kinematics modeling (rather than obeying modeling conventions such as the Denavit-Hartenberg convention) and to avoid introduction of joint frames. The computational efficiency is owed to a representation of twists, accelerations, and wrenches that minimizes the computational effort.

arxiv-2405-01105.title: Image segmentation of treated and untreated tumor spheroids by Fully Convolutional Networks
arxiv-2405-01105.creator: Matthias Streller, Soňa Michlíková, Willy Ciecior, Katharina Lönnecke, Leoni A. Kunz-Schughart, Steffen Lange, Anja Voss-Böhme
arxiv-2405-01105.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthias Streller, Soňa Michlíková, Willy Ciecior, Katharina Lönnecke, Leoni A. Kunz-Schughart, Steffen Lange, Anja Voss-Böhme. Background and objectives Multicellular tumor spheroids (MCTS) are advanced cell culture systems for assessing the impact of combinatorial radio(chemo)therapy as they exhibit therapeutically relevant in-vivo-like characteristics from 3D cell-cell and cell-matrix interactions to radial pathophysiological gradients. State-of-the-art assays quantify long-term curative endpoints based on collected brightfield image time series from large treated spheroid populations per irradiation dose and treatment arm.

arxiv-2508-17919.title: Log translation invariance of log soft gravitational radiation
arxiv-2508-17919.creator: Gianni Boschetti, Miguel Campiglia
arxiv-2508-17919.description: Abstract The gravitational radiation emitted during a classical scattering process is known to exhibit two universal logarithmic terms in its soft frequency expansion. arxiv-2602-17529.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential across a variety of tasks, but their application in the telecom field remains challenging due to domain complexity, evolving standards, and specialized terminology. pmc-11512362.title: Abundance Trends of Immature Stages of Ticks at Different Distances from Hiking Trails from a Natural Park in North-Western Italy
pmc-11512362.creator: Rachele Vada, Stefania Zanet, Elena Battisti, Ezio Ferroglio
pmc-11512362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryHiking trails in a natural park may increase the risk of tick exposure for people and pets, as ticks dropped by wildlife can easily latch onto individuals walking nearby. Understanding the range of movement of ticks dropped by wildlife hosts on trails, along with the acarological risks linked to park infrastructures, is crucial for guiding actions to reduce exposure to ticks and tick-borne pathogens.

pmc-12794729.title: Heart Rate Variability as a Predictor of Mortality in Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12794729.creator: Indresh Yadav, Raja Waqas, Ahmad Mohammad, Usman G Lashari, Mariam Sabra, Abdallah Dwayat, Jaisingh Rajput
pmc-12794729.description: Heart rate variability (HRV), a marker of autonomic function, has been proposed as a prognostic tool in heart failure (HF), but evidence remains fragmented. This meta-analysis synthesizes data on HRV’s predictive value for mortality in HF. Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and other databases (2000-2024) were systematically searched for studies assessing HRV and mortality in HF.

uslaw-usc-t29-s49c.title: 29 U.S.C. § 49c — Acceptance by States; creation of State agencies
uslaw-usc-t29-s49c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s49c.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 4B (Federal Employment Service). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In order to obtain the benefits of appropriations apportioned under section 49d of this title, a State shall, pursuant to State statute, accept the provisions of this chapter and, in accordance with such State statute, the Governor shall designate or authorize the creation of a State.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3222.title: 42 U.S.C. § 3222 — Savings clause
uslaw-usc-t42-s3222.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s3222.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 38 (Public Works And Economic Development); Subchapter VI (Miscellaneous). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To the extent that any portion of grants made under this chapter are used for an economic development project that involves remediation, the remediation shall be conducted in compliance with all applicable Federal, State, and local laws.
